definitions.explanation: To revise or change established standards, prices, rules, or rates. Typically used for official changes to numerical values or established norms rather than text.

examples.japanese: {運賃|うんちん}が{改定|かいてい}された。
{来月|らいげつ}から{料金|りょうきん}の{改定|かいてい}が{実施|じっし}される。
examples.english: A rate revision will be implemented from next month.

examples.japanese: {最低|さいてい}{賃金|ちんぎん}の{改定|かいてい}について{労使|ろうし}が{協議|きょうぎ}している。
examples.english: Labor and management are negotiating the revision of the minimum wage.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for revising prices, rates, standards, and regulations. Distinguished from the homophone {改訂|かいてい}, which refers to revising written texts and documents. A helpful mnemonic: {改定|かいてい} uses {定|てい} (to fix/establish), so it concerns fixed values like prices; {改訂|かいてい} uses {訂|てい} (to correct text), so it concerns written documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}: rate revision
- {運賃|うんちん}{改定|かいてい}: fare revision
- {価格|かかく}{改定|かいてい}: price revision
- {基準|きじゅん}の{改定|かいてい}: revision of standards

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {改訂|かいてい}: revision of text/documents (homophone, different kanji)
